notes.title: Emoji Charades is Available Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're so excited to say that Emoji Charades is now available on Steam. I hope you were able to take advantage of the 20% launch discount, but if not, no worries - we will be offering another discount sometime in the near future.

If you were generous enough to purchase the game so far, I hope you have a chance to get your friends or family together to play Emoji Charades over the weekend!

As you're playing the game, make sure to check out the Loyalty Program where you can earn a free Puppy pack just for signing up, and you can win gift cards and other prizes by just playing the game.

More news as it comes,

Vexir

notes.title: Pre-Release Build is Playable!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Thanks for your patience with us. As of this week, the pre-release build should be fully functional and compatible with the mobile companion apps.

If you have any trouble playing the game, please reach out to outreach@gamecakestudios.com.

- Vex

notes.title: Current Pre-Release Build is Broken - Fix On The Way!
notes.content:
To Curators that have accepted a pre-release copy of Emoji Charades:

The current pre-release build is incompatible with the live game on the App Stores and will not connect to the App Store apps that are required to play. We are working on a fix and will have an update next week.

Thank you for your patience!

- Vexir
